title: A client shares the estimate with someone else

steps.caption: Clients
steps.narration: An estimate often needs a second opinion. Your client can share it, and you see who it went to.

steps.caption: The client's estimate
steps.narration: First, your client's screen. They have the estimate open.

steps.caption: Need someone else to see this?
steps.narration: Under the estimate is a box that asks: need someone else to see this?

steps.caption: The other person's address
steps.narration: They type the other person's email address.

steps.caption: Shared with
steps.narration: The page confirms who it was shared with. That person gets their own link by email.

steps.caption: Back to the CRM
steps.narration: Now your screen, in the CRM.

steps.caption: The estimate
steps.narration: Under Estimates, his estimate has a new note: one access event.

steps.caption: Who and when
steps.narration: It shows who your client shared the estimate with, and when.

steps.caption: Where to find it
steps.narration: You will find this on the client's page, under Clients.

youtube.title: When a client shares your estimate | ConstructHUB CRM
youtube.description: In the ConstructHUB CRM a client can share an estimate with a spouse or business partner from the estimate page. The other person gets their own secure link, and you see who it was shared with. Recorded in a demo workspace with made-up people.
